title: Recording: Dead Giveaway by Ringo Starr | 1980
content:
Cherokee Studios, Los Angeles
Producers: Ringo Starr, Ronnie Wood
Engineer: Dee Robb

Ringo Starr finished recording ‘Dead Giveaway’ for his eighth studio album, Stop And Smell The Roses, on 24 September 1980.

The song was co-written and co-produced by Starr and The Rolling Stones’ Ronnie Wood.

Starr and Wood also recorded several songs which didn’t make it onto Stop And Smell The Roses: ‘Brandy’, ‘Don’t Blame It On Me’, and a demo entitled ‘I Don’t Believe You’.
